payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the performance of multilingual BERT (M-Bert) in various settings, including cross-lingual and cross-target scenarios, as well as its general accuracy in stance detection tasks.

claims.text: M-Bert performs better than majority class baselines in cross-lingual and cross-target settings, although its performance is lower than supervised scores.
M-Bert has established itself as state-of-the-art for various multilingual tasks and can outperform feature-based and other neural approaches in monolingual English settings.
M-Bert shows moderate success in zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-target transfer for stance detection.
In cross-lingual and cross-target settings, M-Bert's mean score drops by 6–8 percentage points compared to the supervised setting, indicating room for improvement.
